schematic.renderCoordinateUnit: Uncalibrated schematic unit, not a supplied physical value.
schematic.justification: Rectify scan skew and make the explicitly described equal-amplitude harmonic translation exact. Period 350 follows the first-to-second crest pixel separation; shift 60 follows the first crest pair. Later intervals and shift differ by a few scan pixels. None of these schematic numbers is drawn, and the ratios are not claimed as given numerical data.
schematic.endpointPolicy: Both curves stop at the observed source right-edge column 965 mapped to s=915; no extension beyond their source domain.
schematic.nativePolicy: Sample after recording defining anchors; include every zero, extremum, curve intersection and leader attachment explicitly, then connect using native JSXGraph segments.
modernAdditions: Rectified continuous axes replace the slightly tilted scan and its small horizontal scan gap.
Invisible-size native anchor dots and sampled connecting segments enable executable relationships; no visible point dots are introduced.
Expanded vertical composition and 640px scroll media keep all symbolic labels at least 16px.
Literal mathematical glyphs and the vector-accent arrow are preserved with renderer-owned vector text and native arrows.
forbiddenAdditions: inferred numeric time or phase difference
